about: ORIGINAL kid-friendly garment catalogue in the XY fashion language (see style_dna.txt). No XY designs copied: logos/emblems/creature prints are our own. All hex values in colourways are concrete.

pattern_params.stripes_h/v: {width: fraction of garment height/width (0.02-0.12), gap: fraction, count: int or "all", placement: all|lower_half|band_hem|band_chest|sleeves, colour: role}
pattern_params.print_motif: {motif: text, placement: chest_centre|hem_left|all_over_sparse|back, scale: small|medium|large, colours: roles}

notes: Hem lengths are relative to the wearer: short = 0.55-0.6 of knee->hip measured up from knee; above_knee = 0.15-0.3; knee; below_knee; midi = mid calf; ankle.

Kid-friendly rules: skirts/dresses for toddler..teen always set details built_in_shorts or are worn with leggings/tights/knee socks in outfits; no cropped tops; swimwear = rash guard / modest one-piece with skirt or shorts.
Shoes length uses: low | ankle_boot | mid_calf | below_knee_boot. Legwear length uses ankle_sock | crew | knee_high | over_knee | full_leg. Bags/hats use small|medium|large|extra_large for size.

generator_rules: Pick outfit palette: 1 dominant + 1 neutral + 1 accent; accent must appear on >=2 items (hat/bag/socks/tie).
Max 4 chromatic hues per outfit; max 1 patterned main garment (socks may add a 2nd).
Top/bottom HSV value contrast >= 0.25 except monochrome uniforms.
Shade colour = main * 0.75 (warm hues shift 3-5 deg toward red); highlight = mix with offwhite 25%.
Children/teens wearing skirts/dresses must have built_in_shorts or leggings/tights/knee socks; no cropped or bare-midriff tops; swimwear = rash guard/one-piece with skirt/board shorts.
Hats 1.3-1.6x head width; sneaker sole 1/4 of shoe height; bags 0.6-0.9x torso height.
